data.script: Shoppers trust a support bot twice as much when it can do 1 thing. Hand them to a person. In a survey of 3,000 shoppers, 55 in 100 trust AI when a human option exists. Without one, just 26. So before Black Friday, make sure your bot hands off in 5 moments. An angry customer. Anyone trying to cancel. A refund over your limit. A question it isn't sure about. And anyone who asks for a human. That's how we build support bots at Content Systems.ai. An apparel brand we work with in Berlin lets AI answer 72 in 100 tickets, and still saves 1 in 4 customers who try to cancel. Comment SYSTEMS for the handoff map.
